skills.name: emails
skills.purpose: Plans and writes lifecycle email programs: welcome, onboarding, nurture, re-engagement, billing and other trigger-based sequences, with timing, per-email specs and copy guidelines.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'email sequence', 'drip campaign', 'welcome sequence', 'lifecycle emails', 're-engagement emails'. Reads the repo's product-marketing context file if present; no API keys.
skills.evidence: marketingskills (52.7k stars); skills.sh ~67.2k installs, plus ~55.8k under its former name email-sequence; on the skills.sh trending list (Oct 2026); in VoltAgent list; listed on Smithery
skills.notes: Strategy and copy only; pair with a sending/ESP skill. Formerly named email-sequence.

skills.name: cold-email
skills.purpose: Writes B2B cold emails and follow-up sequences that get replies: frameworks, personalisation, subject lines, follow-up cadence and reply-rate benchmarks.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'cold email', 'cold outreach', 'prospecting email', 'SDR emails', 'follow-up sequence'. No API keys.
skills.evidence: marketingskills (52.7k stars); skills.sh ~116.6k installs; on the skills.sh trending list (Oct 2026); in VoltAgent list
skills.notes: Copy-focused: it does not cover CAN-SPAM/GDPR/CASL rules or sending infrastructure, so pair it with email-best-practices. The sales-outreach chain also covers outbound.

skills.name: lead-magnets
skills.purpose: Plans and builds lead magnets for email capture (checklists, templates, guides, tools, quizzes): format choice, gating and opt-in placement, delivery and conversion benchmarks.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'lead magnet', 'opt-in', 'gated content', 'content upgrade', 'freebie', 'email capture content'. No API keys.
skills.evidence: marketingskills (52.7k stars); skills.sh ~102.7k installs
skills.notes: Sibling skills in the same repo: popups (email capture popups) and signup.

skills.name: react-email
skills.purpose: Builds HTML email templates with React Email components (welcome, password reset, order confirmation, newsletter), styling with Tailwind, i18n, rendering to HTML/plain text, the embeddable visual editor, and sending with Resend.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on building or rendering HTML emails in React; needs Node with react-email / @react-email/components. References cover components, styling, i18n, editor and sending.
skills.evidence: Official React Email (Resend), 19.8k stars; skills.sh ~9.2k installs (plus ~10.7k for the same file shipped in resend/resend-skills); in VoltAgent list; listed on Smithery
skills.notes: Default branch is canary. Identical copy ships in resend/resend-skills.

skills.name: email-sequence
skills.purpose: Designs and drafts complete multi-email sequences (onboarding, lead nurture, re-engagement, win-back, product launch) with full copy, timing, branching and exit conditions, A/B test ideas and benchmarks, plus a flow diagram.
skills.how_to_use: Run `/email-sequence [sequence type]` from Anthropic's marketing plugin (Cowork or Claude Code); uses a connected email platform if one is attached.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic (knowledge-work marketing plugin), 26k stars; skills.sh ~2.8k installs

skills.name: email-template-builder
skills.purpose: Builds a transactional email system: React Email base layout and templates, one send function over Resend/Postmark/SendGrid/AWS SES, preview server, i18n, dark mode, spam-score checklist and analytics tracking.
skills.how_to_use: Use when adding transactional email to a product, migrating providers or refactoring legacy templates; code patterns for a Node/TypeScript stack.
skills.evidence: alirezarezvani/claude-skills (27.5k stars), engineering-team plugin
skills.notes: Code patterns, so check package versions against current provider docs.

skills.name: resend
skills.purpose: Works with the Resend API end to end: single and batch transactional sends, inbound email via webhooks, templates, delivery events, domains, contacts, segments, topics, broadcasts, automations, logs and usage.
skills.how_to_use: Needs RESEND_API_KEY (and RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET for webhooks). Triggers on any Resend or 'send email from my app' task. Install via `npx skills add resend/resend-skills` or the repo's Claude Code plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Resend; skills.sh ~20.6k installs; in VoltAgent list; Resend skills on the skills.sh hot list
skills.notes: Repo has few stars; ranked on official origin and installs. Siblings: resend-cli (~11.2k installs) and agent-email-inbox (safe handling of untrusted inbound email for agents).

skills.name: email-best-practices
skills.purpose: Provider-agnostic email guide: SPF/DKIM/DMARC and deliverability, one-click unsubscribe and Gmail/Yahoo sender rules, email capture and double opt-in, CAN-SPAM/GDPR/CASL, list management, transactional vs marketing, a transactional email catalog, webhooks/retries and accessibility.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on emails going to spam, high bounces, authentication setup, compliance, email capture, retry logic or accessibility. No API key needed.
skills.evidence: Official Resend; skills.sh ~7.9k installs (from its standalone source repo resend/email-best-practices); in VoltAgent list; on the skills.sh hot list
skills.notes: The standalone source repo resend/email-best-practices has no LICENSE file, so use this MIT copy in resend-skills.

skills.name: cloudflare-email-service

skills.name: amazon-ses

skills.name: deliverability-qa
skills.purpose: Pre-send deliverability check: SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI alignment from DNS and DMARC aggregate reports, domain/IP reputation (Postmaster/SNDS), seed-list inbox placement, spam-content/link/render scan and a bounce/complaint snapshot, scored Pass/Partial/Fail/Unknown.
skills.how_to_use: Say 'run a deliverability pre-flight for <domain>' and supply a DNS export, DMARC RUA report and seed test. Optional keyless DNS-over-HTTPS lookup (dns.google / cloudflare-dns.com) and a read-only Resend connector script.
skills.evidence: aaron-marketing-skills (2.9k stars); skills.sh ~908 installs; the repo is in the VoltAgent list
skills.notes: One of 16 email skills in the bundle (list-growth-designer, list-hygiene-monitor, list-segment-builder, email-sequence-designer, reactivation-specialist, send-experiment-designer, email-render-builder, ...). Leans on the bundle's shared protocol (memory files, consent-registry, email-quality-auditor), so install the whole plugin. PRIVACY.md: no telemetry, and hooks make no network calls.

skills.name: subject-line-lab
skills.purpose: Generates labelled subject-line and preview-text (preheader) variants and pre-scores each: spam-trigger flags, truncation on desktop and mobile, emoji count and the full inbox preview (from-name + subject + preheader), before any A/B test.
skills.how_to_use: Say 'generate subject line variants' or 'will this subject get truncated'. Hands off to send-experiment-designer in the same bundle for the actual A/B test plan (sample size, MDE, holdouts).
skills.evidence: aaron-marketing-skills (2.9k stars); skills.sh ~877 installs
skills.notes: Same bundle and protocol caveat as deliverability-qa.
